content.user_title: Create Clear GitHub Issues from Raw Notes
content.value_statement: Bug reports often arrive as logs, screenshots, and scattered notes. This skill turns them into structured GitHub Markdown issues with clear impact, steps, and context.
actual_capabilities: Transforms raw notes, error logs, and voice dictation into GitHub-flavored Markdown issue reports.
Uses sections for summary, environment, reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, impact, and context.
Creates issue files under the repository /issues directory with date-based filenames.
References attached screenshots or GIFs inline as visual evidence.
Suggests issue severity from the described user or service impact.
limitations: Does not create issues through the GitHub API or GitHub CLI.
Depends on the user to provide accurate product, version, and environment details.
May infer missing context from conversation, so reviewers should verify facts before filing.
Does not upload images or validate attachment filenames.

use_cases.title: Turn Support Notes into Issues
use_cases.description: Convert customer reports, screenshots, and reproduction notes into a consistent issue ready for engineering review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Bug Reports During Triage
use_cases.description: Summarize error logs and user impact into clear reproduction steps and expected versus actual behavior.

use_cases.title: Capture Developer Debugging Findings
use_cases.description: Document local failures, stack traces, and environment details as a Markdown file in the repository.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Bug Issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a short bug description.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GitHub issue from this bug note. Include summary, environment, steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, impact, and context: [paste note].

prompt_templates.title: Convert an Error Log
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for logs and observed behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this error log and short description into a GitHub Markdown issue. Preserve important error text and replace sensitive values with placeholders: [paste log].

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Screenshot-Based Issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for visual evidence and reproduction detail.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an issue using this screenshot description and attached image names. Reference each image inline and infer only missing fields supported by the conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Release Blocking Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for triage-ready release issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release-blocking GitHub issue from these notes. Highlight severity, affected workflow, regression risk, workaround status, and exact verification steps.

output_examples.input: The dashboard save button spins forever after editing a widget. Chrome on Windows. It worked yesterday.
output_examples.output: A structured GitHub issue with a one-line summary, browser environment, save workflow steps, expected save confirmation, actual infinite spinner, and high impact as a regression.

output_examples.input: Publishing fails with PERMISSION_DENIED code 403 when sending an agent to a Teams channel.
output_examples.output: A GitHub issue describing the 403 publishing failure, affected integration, two reproduction steps, expected successful publish, actual permission error, and blocked Teams workflow impact.

output_examples.input: Screenshot shows the checkout total overlapping the tax line on mobile after rotating the phone.
output_examples.output: A visual bug issue with mobile environment details, rotation steps, expected separated totals, actual overlapping text, inline screenshot reference, and medium severity.

best_practices: Provide product, version, region, browser, operating system, and exact user action when available.
Include raw error text and screenshot filenames, then let the skill organize them into the template.
Review inferred details and placeholders before publishing the generated issue.
anti_patterns: Do not paste secrets, tokens, private customer data, or internal identifiers without redaction.
Do not ask the skill to invent reproduction steps that were not observed or supported by context.
Do not use the generated issue as final truth without validating environment and impact details.

faq.question: Does this skill create GitHub issues directly?
faq.answer: No. It creates Markdown issue files that a user can review before publishing.

faq.question: Can it use screenshots or GIFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can reference attached image or GIF filenames inline as visual evidence.

faq.question: Will it redact sensitive data?
faq.answer: It instructs the model to use placeholders for sensitive values, but users should review all output.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Error logs, short bug notes, voice dictation, screenshots, and observed user impact work well.

faq.question: Can it choose issue severity?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps severity to impact, such as outages, blocked workflows, impairments, or cosmetic problems.

faq.question: Is it limited to GitHub?
faq.answer: The output uses GitHub-flavored Markdown, but the structure can help with many issue trackers.
